item.revisedPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single-frame 2D RPG character movement sprite.
Reference image 1 is the authoritative original identity: water dragon scholar boy 15. Reference image 2 is ONLY the main approved hand-painted style/material/polish reference, do not copy its UI or figures. Reference image 3 fixes this batch's body proportions and all outfit details from the same character.
Create exactly ONE full-body boy, centered, transparent PNG, requested native 1024 x 1024 minimum, never a grid or sheet. Preserve identity, round chibi head and short limbs, navy-blue straight layered hair tied in small high bun, turquoise-and-gold hair ornament and blue ribbons, blue/ivory/gold layered Taoist scholar robes with clouds and wave patterns, gold-edged shoulder ornaments and turquoise details, jade belt buckle and jade waist charm, blue-and-gold shoes. Anatomical RIGHT hand ALWAYS holds the same open ivory blue water-dragon folding fan with gold trim, black fan ribs, jade and blue tassel. Both arms stay relaxed close to the body with only natural small walking swing; no attack or presentation pose.
Match clean bright polished soft hand-painted chibi rendering with fine line edges, tactile cloth and jade, consistent soft upper-left lighting. Lock body size and camera: slight downward 12-degree game camera, full figure head tip around y=70 and grounded support foot around y=940 on a 1024 canvas, body axis x=512, generous clear transparent margin all around. No environment, ground, shadow oval, halo, colored fringe, writing, labels, extra limbs, new props, facial changes, costume redesign, or cropped feet.
Frame: NE WALK 16/16, exact back-right THREE-QUARTER view facing and moving diagonally AWAY toward UPPER-RIGHT of screen. Keep NE angle from image4: back of head/back robe dominate, at most tiny right ear/cheek profile, NO front view or direct eye contact. Feet, head, torso all face upper-right. Image4 is independent NE rest anchor; image5 when supplied is prior walking phase/proportions reference. LEFT far-side shoe is almost at heel contact forward toward upper-right, still a tiny gap above floor, nearly the frame01 lead-left contact. RIGHT near-side toe supports behind toward lower-left with heel modestly raised. Torso returns to neutral, robe and tassel settle toward frame01. True independently drawn pre-contact phase, do not reuse01. Compared with image5, far LEFT shoe points toward upper-right and lightly extends heel, near RIGHT shoe at lower-left rolls heel down slightly; both shoes appear closer together along the path, step length 20pixels shorter than contact01. Preserve centered head, changing only subtle pelvis/ankle/cloth articulation. No isolated background marks. Maintain direction, framing, head size and costume. Create one new articulated walking phase with actual knee/ankle/cloth changes.
